{{Quote|The boy's a Jedi. Kill him.|Boba Fett, to the Druulgothans and other patrons at Al the Alchemist's cantina|<ref name="Lost Jedi" />}}
The '''Druulgothans''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]]-like [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]]<ref name="Lost Jedi" /> native to the [[Druulgotha system/Legends|Druulgotha system]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]].<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> They were present in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], several Druulgothans visited a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]. The cantina, [[Al The Alchemist's]], was patronized by [[Smuggler/Legends|gun-runners]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; the infamous [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] among them.<ref name="Lost Jedi" />

Also present in the cantina at the [[Time/Legends|time]] was [[Havet Storm]], a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] boy whose [[Morvet Storm|grandfather]] had been a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. The patrons soon discovered that Storm was carrying a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], so the bar-goers&mdash;Druulgothans included&mdash;gathered around the boy and stared at him with hostility. Fett, who bore a grudge against the boy from a previous encounter, ordered the assorted patrons of the cantina to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Storm,<ref name="Lost Jedi" /> but the boy was able to escape.<ref name="Dark Forces">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050616a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 6: Outcasts and Megalomaniacs Welcome}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|They are standing around you in a close ring &ndash; humans, lizard-like Druulgothans, Ma'alkerrite ape-men, winged Banasthaurs &ndash; gun-runners, mercenaries, and bounty hunters from all across the galaxy. And they are all staring at you.|The Druulgothans are mentioned in the front matter of ''The Lost Jedi''|<ref name="Lost Jedi" />}}
The Druulgothans were created by [[Paul Cockburn]], author of the pick-a-path adventure ''[[Jedi Dawn]]'', published by [[Boxtree]] in [[1993]]. The species is not mentioned in the adventure itself, but is only mentioned in the front matter immediately following the book's cover. The scene described here closely matches a scene contained in the adventure, which includes the same quotation from Boba Fett. In this scene, the reader is given three choices as to how to react to the situation. If the reader chooses to try to talk his or her way out of the confrontation, the lightsaber is snatched away by a "a lizard-faced creature with a rasping voice," which could correspond to one of the Druulgothans.<ref name="Lost Jedi" /> The Druulgothans are also mentioned in the front matter of ''[[The Lost Jedi Adventure Game Book]]'', published in [[1992]], which collected ''Jedi Dawn'' and its sequel, ''[[The Bounty Hunter]]''.
